sentences.text: 4 Of Dowry Of Prohibition Act vs In Re : Subrata Halder

on 4 March, 2025 04.03.2025  17  sdas Allowed  C.R.M. (A) No. 752 of 2025  In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section  482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita in connection  with Englishbazar Police Station Case No. 8 of 2024 dated  02.01.2024 under Sections 498A/306 of the Indian Penal Code  (presently under Sections 85/226 of the BNS) read with Section  4 of Dowry of Prohibition Act.
And  In Re : Subrata Halder ..... petitioner
Mr. Kalyan Kumar Chakraborty
Mr. Gopal Krishna Sarkar
Mr. Kashinath Bhattacharjee  .....for the petitioner  Mr. Saibal Bapuli, learned APP  Ms., Baishakhi Chatterjee  ....for the State

1.
Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits he is the husband of the victim lady.
It is also contended he has been falsely implicated at the behest of his parents-in-law.
He prays for anticipatory bail.
2. Learned Counsel for the State produces the case diary.
3. We have considered the materials on record.
Petitioner is husband of the victim lady.
She committed suicide.
Her suicide note exonerates the petitioner.
Accordingly we are inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

4. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest the petitioner shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-, with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita and on condition that he shall appear before the jurisdictional court and pray for regular bail within a period of four weeks from date.
